purpose: Compare requested CPU dense precision profiles using the same exported checkpoint and unchanged quality scoring.

frozen_runtime.packing: Grouped planar int4, one scale per 64 input values

mlp_head.note: The shexp tag selects the MLP even when there are no routed experts; other eligible projections retain the default precision.

all.note: Requests four-bit packing only for eligible tagged matrices, not every model tensor.

execution_requirements: Complete the original training and full output/provenance audit.
Review actual exports and grant separate exact-source, exact-profile execution admission.
Use the same checkpoint and unchanged primary questions, labels, scorer and budgets.
Keep one experimental worker and no concurrent training/export, with existing ownership, limits and cleanup.
Require unchanged quality/security/retention acceptance before any production configuration change.
limitations: The CPU loader can retain int8 if four-bit allocation fails; the frozen CPU engine does not expose per-matrix precision counters.
Actual four-bit matrix coverage is unverified. Results identify requested profiles, not proven universal four-bit storage.
Quantization changes arithmetic and can reduce accuracy; no quality result is available.
Neither latency nor RAM improvement has been measured.
Cold/warm repeatability, full application timings and broad acceptance remain pending.
